scenarios.title: How does our rule engine decide?
scenarios.introAfter: prepared to show how our rule engine (RFM segmentation + Next-Best-Offer scorer) decides using real data — they do not belong to a real customer. The scores are real, verified results from our test suite.

ayse.name: Ayşe — Motorcycle Enthusiast
ayse.profile: A profile with frequent, regular spending over the last 90 days, mostly in the motorcycle category.
ayse.why: Category match (+45) · RFM activity bonus (+16) · propensity (+25, an untargeted campaign is considered suitable for everyone)

mehmet.name: Mehmet — Investor & SWIFT User
mehmet.profile: A profile with an investment account, regular international transfers, and concentrated spending in the travel category.
mehmet.why: Category match (+45) · special product fit for SWIFT users (+10) · RFM activity bonus (+17) · propensity (+25, untargeted)

zeynep.name: Zeynep — Low-Activity Profile
zeynep.profile: A profile with low recent transaction frequency and amount, with only a handful of purchases in the groceries category.
zeynep.why: Neither the category nor the propensity matches — the rule engine chooses to stay silent rather than send an offer to the wrong customer.

securityPage.title: Your data never leaves your bank.
securityPage.intro: Finara performs customer segmentation and campaign matching with explainable rule engines; the AI layer connects to a local model (Ollama) running on your own infrastructure, not to cloud APIs. No customer data is ever sent to a third-party AI provider.

localAi.title: Local AI
localAi.text: Segment commentary and customer analyses are produced by a local language model running on your bank's own infrastructure. The rule engine (RFM/Next-Best-Offer) is always the primary decision mechanism — AI only offers an explanatory second opinion, it never changes the decision.

auth.title: Authentication & Access
auth.text: Passwords are hashed with PBKDF2-SHA256 and never stored as plain text. Sessions are protected with short-lived JWTs plus rotating refresh tokens; tokens are stored in the DB only in hashed form.

isolation.title: Bank-Scoped Isolation
isolation.text: In the multi-tenant architecture, each bank sees only its own data. Role-based access control (Super Admin/Bank Admin) is enforced separately in both the UI and the API.

kvkk.title: GDPR/KVKK Compliance
kvkk.text: Customer data is permanently anonymized when the right to be forgotten is requested and is never included in segmentation/automation processes again.

audit.title: Audit Log
audit.text: All campaign, offer, consent, and admin account changes are written to the audit log with who/when information — viewable from a separate reporting screen for retrospective traceability.

validation.title: Input Validation & Rate Limiting
validation.text: Bulk import and export are sanitized against formula injection, all endpoints are protected against abuse with rate limiting, and the database runs in an isolated environment.
